messages:
maria: quick check — I'm debugging a spike in SM% on the canary pool yesterday around 11:10 UTC. where's the canonical SM% heatmap + per-gpu mem panel? also need kvcache evictions/traces for that timeframe. cc @kevin
kevin: for SM% heatmap look at Grafana -> https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/sm-heatmap/sm-gpu-heatmap?orgId=1&from=now-6h (use the time picker to narrow).
kevin: kvcache metrics live on the inference-overview dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/inference-overview/kvcache?from=now-6h. for traces filter service=inference and span:evict in the tracing UI.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: alert GPU_SM_HIGH fired on pool-canary at 2026-02-15T11:12:34Z (instances: 3) — link: https://alerts.redwood.ai/alerts/2345
anya: quick tip — if you want raw eviction logs try: `kubectl logs -l app=inference -c worker --since=2h | rg "evict|kvcache" -n` helped me trace a stray batch size change last week.
dan: question on alert tuning: current threshold is 85% SM for canary and it's noisy. propose raising to 90% with a 10m cooldown. Thoughts?
kevin: 90% + 10m cooldown sounds reasonable for canary. for prod we keep stricter. I'll open a small PR to update the alert rule and add a note in the runbook.
maria: thanks — can you also add the dashboard panel IDs in the PR so I can link them from the incident doc?
kevin: yep, will add `panelId=17` (SM heatmap) and `panelId=9` (kvcache hit/evict). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/monitoring/pull/412
maria: pinging for quick review @kevin — also adding a repro query here: `traceql "service==\"inference\" and span==\"kv.evict\" and timestamp >= now()-2h"`.
kevin: got it, review incoming in ~30m.
anya: extra note — if you suspect batch-size change, check the autoscaler logs too: `kubectl logs deploy/autoscaler -n infra --since=6h | rg batch`. saved me before.
dan: sounds good. thanks everyone. i'll wait for the PR to merge before updating runbook. :thumbsup:
maria: perfect — closing the loop once PR is merged. thanks all!
